answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 36012 Country: India Title: Duaa after burial of janazah in Qabrastan Question: Is dua talqeen after burial of janazah mandatory? What are the Duas that may be recited in graveyard after burial? Answer ID: 36012 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 135/135/M=1433) (1) It is not necessary. (2) It is afdhal to recite the first part of surah al-Baqrah to head side of the dead and the last part of surah al-Baqarah to his foot side. It is proved from hadith: عن عبدالله بن عمر مرفوعاً ، وليقرأ عند رأسه فاتحة البقره وعند رجليه بخاتمه البقرة (مشكوة) . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
